source: SAMPLE DATA — general alignment with Gainsight/Totango-style CS intervention playbooks, NOT sourced from a specific cited section of either vendor's proprietary methodology. Must be replaced with an institution-verified playbook before production use.
institution_scope_note: This recommendation reflects an unverified sample CS playbook only. Institution-specific application is the responsibility of the Customer Success leadership team.

recommendations.Red:product_adoption: Executive escalation: schedule an urgent adoption workshop and assign a dedicated onboarding specialist to reverse the usage decline.
recommendations.Red:support_health: Executive escalation: convene a support review with engineering leadership to resolve the outstanding ticket backlog and prevent further severity escalation.
recommendations.Red:relationship: Executive escalation: arrange an executive-to-executive check-in to rebuild relationship trust before the renewal decision.
recommendations.Red:commercial_risk: Executive escalation: initiate a pricing/packaging review to realign contract scope with actual usage before renewal.
recommendations.Yellow:product_adoption: Schedule a targeted training session on underused features to improve adoption trend.
recommendations.Yellow:support_health: Conduct a QBR focused on recent support themes; assign a technical account manager if ticket volume persists.
recommendations.Yellow:relationship: Schedule a QBR to re-engage the account team and confirm stakeholder alignment.
recommendations.Yellow:commercial_risk: Review contract utilization with the account team; consider a right-sizing or expansion conversation.
recommendations.Green:product_adoption: Maintain regular adoption check-ins; no urgent action required.
recommendations.Green:support_health: Continue standard support cadence; no urgent action required.
recommendations.Green:relationship: Continue standard relationship touchpoints; consider this account for a case-study or testimonial conversation.
recommendations.Green:commercial_risk: Continue standard commercial cadence; consider a proactive expansion conversation given healthy utilization.
